items.stem: Nandini and Kavya share profits 5:3. items.answer: Realisation loss ₹38,000: Nandini ₹23,750, Kavya ₹14,250

items.stem: Prepare the cash flow statement of Satpura Ltd for the year ended 31 March 2026 from: net profit before tax ₹9,90,000; depreciation ₹45,000; outstanding expenses increased by ₹38,000; prepaid expenses increased by ₹7,000; trade receivables decreased by ₹38,000; income tax paid ₹1,05,000. Machinery (net) was ₹2,40,000 at the start and ₹4,60,000 at the end; a machine of book value ₹75,000 was sold for ₹84,000; depreciation as above. Interest received on investments ₹6,000. Equity shares of ₹5,00,000 were issued for cash. 8% debentures (₹10,00,000 at the start) decreased by ₹2,00,000 on 31 March 2026. Interest on debentures was paid in full. Dividend paid ₹80,000. Cash and cash equivalents at the beginning ₹50,000.
items.answer: Operating ₹10,64,000; investing −₹2,50,000; financing ₹1,40,000; net change ₹9,54,000; closing cash ₹10,04,000
items.markingKey: Operating: NPBT ₹9,90,000 + depreciation ₹45,000 − profit on sale of machinery ₹9,000 + interest on debentures ₹80,000 − interest received ₹6,000 = ₹11,00,000; working capital changes +₹38,000, −₹7,000, +₹38,000 → ₹11,69,000; less tax ₹1,05,000 = ₹10,64,000 (3 marks). Investing: sale ₹84,000 − purchase of machinery ₹3,40,000 (closing + depreciation + book value sold − opening) + interest ₹6,000 = −₹2,50,000 (1½ marks). Financing: shares ₹5,00,000 − debentures ₹2,00,000 − interest ₹80,000 − dividend ₹80,000 = ₹1,40,000 (1½ marks). Net change ₹9,54,000; closing cash and cash equivalents ₹10,04,000.
